name: Sound Lab
description: A tour of the audio core: one-shots, buses and their effects, snapshots, ducking and a moving spatial source. Click the game view, then press 1-6 to try each feature. The other keys run the audio listening pass's tests (see the Listening bench node). Press E for the events page: footsteps by surface, an engine blended by RPM with a key-off tail, and music that gets more intense. Press S for the spatial page: walk a corridor of reverb zones past walls, a door you open with F, an ambisonic ambience and a Doppler flyover (V).
